name: Washing Machine Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solution for washing machine manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The washing machine production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for washing machine manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process including component supply, inner drum assembly, shell assembly, electrical installation, vibration damping installation, online inspection, automatic packaging, and intelligent warehousing.

Technical Advantages

  • High degree of full-line automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Multi-model flexible switching, short changeover time
  • Online inspection system to ensure product quality
  • Intelligent data collection for lean production
  • Integration with MES system for full traceability
  • Turnkey project, one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Complex Assembly Process
painPoints.desc: Washing machine assembly involves multiple components with complex processes, making manual assembly difficult

painPoints.title: Long Changeover Time
painPoints.desc: Multi-model production leads to long changeover and debugging times, affecting production capacity

painPoints.title: Numerous Inspection Items
painPoints.desc: Washing machines have many inspection items, and manual inspection is inefficient and prone to missed checks

painPoints.title: Slow Material Flow
painPoints.desc: Inter-process material flow relies on manual labor, making it difficult to coordinate cycle times

painPoints.title: High Quality Fluctuation
painPoints.desc: Inconsistent manual operations lead to unstable product quality

painPoints.title: Difficult Data Collection
painPoints.desc: Production data is recorded manually, lacking real-time capability and making analysis difficult
